citations.claim: first pole_upright violation at step 18: theta -0.893 rad exceeds 0.8 limit; system energy 52.13 shows runaway divergence
one step before failure the system already diverged with high energy 43.56 and theta -0.76 near the limit

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.0116 to 0, keeping all other fields identical and same 18 steps; predicted removes noisy feedback destabilization

explanation: Noisy angle/rate measurements under sensor_noise 0.0116 with seed 1 cause the fixed state-feedback controller to apply wrong saturated forces (62.59 at steps 17-18). This positive feedback drives cart velocity to 9.4 m/s and pole rate to -9 rad/s, pushing theta from 0.05 to -0.89 rad by step 18. With noise removed the same plant/initial condition stays balanced, confirming noise-driven destabilization, likely excessive gains / no filtering for this plant.
vision_note: The cart drifts rightward while the pole leans left with a visibly growing tilt through steps 15 to 17. By step 18 the pole is fallen about 45 degrees from upright and its tip is marked red as the violating body.
